difficulty_reason: A Carleman hyperplane decomposition separates coercive grazing collisions from three bad terms. Quantitative mass-energy-entropy nonconcentration produces anisotropic cone coercivity, and a singular time-dependent polynomial barrier uses the hard-potential velocity gain to dominate every error independently of initial tail constants.
